sources.interest: administrative record kept for taxation, no stake in this voyage

archive_coverage: the Ostia harbour material and the Alexandrian papyri catalogued to 1980 were searched; the Alexandrian customs series is lost, and two provincial archives were not consulted
what_the_record_would_look_like_if_false: the register would carry no entry for this hull in that season, and the letter would not name the same consignment; both are checkable and both were checked
stated_bounds: the surviving register and one contemporary letter
interpretation: Two independent origins record the shipment: an administrative register and a merchant letter. Sources record the voyage; nothing here speaks to how typical it was.
